page.overview:
Who is Zazan?

Zazan is a playable character and antagonist in War of the Visions: Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. Known as the Immortal Cutthroat and the Immortal Beast, he is a wandering warrior affiliated with Gouga notorious for his strength and skill. He is also known as "The Unkillable", as he has the ability to resuscitate himself despite suffering grievous injuries.

Zazan is a bulky man with brown hair and some traces of facial hair, blueish eyes and a scar near his mouth. Zazan wears bear skin to cover his helmet and armor and wears clawed gloves. He wears armored plates on his arms, shoulders and even leggings. He dons gray clothes underneath his armor, and some purple clothing in his lower torso, underneath some brown patches in his armor. In combat he dons a large sword.

Zazan is a brutal man who loves nothing more than slaughter. He is good friends with Rairyuu, who introduced him to the Gouga shinobi clan. Both are mercenaries with a sadistic and cruel streak and no consideration for fair play, even going as far as tormenting those at the receiving end of his ruthlessness. Painfully aware of his immortal condition, Zazan uses it to feign death to attack his foes when they lower their guard, granting him easy albeit cowardly victories.

Although his unexplained immortality is his strongest weapon, it has crushed Zazan's spirit, for as he puts it, he has stared death closely so many times it has left him terrified and shaken so much that he is certain he will eventually die completely.
